reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY product_id, product_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT store_code) < 15
ORDER BY revenue_eur DESC, product_id
LIMIT 3
